hero.title: HAPPY BIRTHDAY LIKITHA
hero.description: A presence that redefined grace and led with quiet intensity—the silent architect of our togetherness. This digital museum celebrates a beautiful journey that is only just beginning.

milestones.title: LR — LEADERSHIP & RESPONSIBILITY
milestones.text: Your calm leadership and maturity naturally earned people’s respect. You carry responsibility with a grace that inspires everyone around you.

milestones.title: CTO — INNOVATION & VISION
milestones.text: A visionary mindset that looks beyond the immediate. Your ability to innovate and see the bigger picture is what sets you apart as a true leader.

milestones.title: 48 HRS HACKATHON — DETERMINATION & FOCUS
milestones.text: Even under pressure, your focus and determination never faded. The 48-hour grind showed your true character and relentless drive.

milestones.title: PUBLIC SPEAKER — CLARITY & CONFIDENCE
milestones.text: Your confidence while speaking always carried clarity and presence. You have a natural ability to command a room and share ideas with impact.

milestones.title: CAREER — AMBITION & GROWTH
milestones.text: Your ambition towards learning and growth continues to inspire everyone around you. You are constantly evolving and reaching for new heights.

milestones.title: TEAM GREENPULSE — TRUST & TOGETHERNESS
milestones.text: The glue that keeps the team together. Your presence fosters trust and a sense of belonging, making every collaboration meaningful.
